The '''Riverfall Wilds''' was part of the expansive jungle that lay to the south of [[Kaas City]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]]. Located south of the eastern part of the city, the Wilds were so named for the waterfall and rivers located in the region. The Wilds were filled with [[yozusk]]s, [[Gundark/Legends|gundarks]], [[Sleen/Legends|sleens]], and [[vine cat]]s, with lightning pylons that drew power from the planet's eternal storms for Kaas City dotting the jungle. The [[Initiate's Path]] ran west of the Wilds.
